wrong_fragment_count.canonical_diagnosis: The Gibson-01 substrate contract requires exactly the supplied linear backbone and PCR insert, each once; correct the fragment list rather than changing a disclosed fragment-count parameter.
acceptable_variants: Use the supplied backbone and insert exactly once each.
The fragment list must contain exactly the Gibson backbone and PCR insert.

citations.title: Gibson Assembly Protocol (E5510)
citations.tier_justification: Official Gibson protocol supports a 2-3-fragment workflow; Gibson-01 fixes that workflow to one supplied backbone and one supplied insert.

wrong_master_mix.canonical_diagnosis: The master mix name is unsupported; use Gibson Assembly Master Mix, NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix, or the exact ISO buffer + T5 exonuclease + Phusion polymerase + Taq DNA ligase formulation.
acceptable_variants: Use an exact supported Gibson-compatible master mix name.
Generic HiFi labels are insufficient; select Gibson Assembly Master Mix, NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix, or the full ISO-buffer enzyme formulation.

wrong_temperature.canonical_diagnosis: This reaction must be run at 50 C; change the Gibson incubation temperature to 50 C.
acceptable_variants: Set the Gibson reaction temperature to 50 C.

wrong_duration.canonical_diagnosis: Use 15-60 minutes for this two-fragment reaction; shorter or longer values violate the Gibson-01 contract.
acceptable_variants: Incubate this two-fragment Gibson reaction for 15 to 60 minutes.
The duration must be between 15 and 60 minutes.

citations.title: Gibson Assembly Protocol (E5510)
citations.tier_justification: Official Gibson E5510 protocol specifies 15 minutes for 2-3 fragments and documents extension to 60 minutes.

wrong_overlap_length.canonical_diagnosis: The supplied fragments have fixed 20 bp homology overlaps, so overlap_length_bp must be 20; it is an observed substrate property, not a free optimization choice.
acceptable_variants: Match the supplied 20 bp homology overlaps exactly.
The task fragments already have 20 bp overlaps, so use overlap_length_bp 20.

citations.title: NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Cloning Kit Manual (E2621/E5520)
citations.tier_justification: Official NEBuilder manual describes 15-20 bp overlaps for 2-3 fragments; the benchmark fixes its observed substrate overlap at the supported 20 bp endpoint.
